Name: Dragon Fairy AT
Author: Roszpunka1990
Description:
This mod will add few variants of dragons into game.  Fairy dragons included.

I used this mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/83608653]Kyuya258369[/url] for inspiration and tameplate. So if you want to use original dragon, download from here.


In order for this mod to work you need to have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] downloaded and added into your mods file.
  This mod only changes the textures of your horse!

[b]Installation
[/b]1.Download and extract the files.
2.Put the main folder in "Mods".

[b]How to change textures
[/b]1. Purchase Scissors from Robin.
2. Use the Scissors tool to apply your chosen texture to entities, in this case your horse.
